title: Literary Theory: An Introduction

vibeProfile.oneLine: Eagleton's classic, opinionated introduction to literary theory.

summary: Terry Eagleton's classic introduction is the most widely read guide to modern literary theory, sweeping from phenomenology and structuralism to psychoanalysis, feminism and post-structuralism. Written with wit, clarity and a strong Marxist point of view, it argues that all criticism is political and that 'literature' itself is a category worth questioning. Provocative and hugely influential, it has introduced generations of students to theory, and remains a bracing, opinionated place to start.
whyReadIt: The most widely read guide to literary theory, witty, clear and provocative. Where generations of students begin.

funFacts.text: It is one of the best-selling works of literary theory ever published.
